verdicts.reason: A keeps the can and has a sensible headline-over-CTA stack in the center. But the SOLSTICE logo is missing, the body copy is squeezed into a tiny three-line block under the badge on the left where it can't be read, and the left cluster is cramped while the right side is mostly empty. B leaves out both the product and the logo, and its oversized CTA outweighs the headline. Its body copy is crushed into an unreadable six-line sliver against the right edge, so it does worse on fidelity and hierarchy.
